data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence, a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Karl Rosander, is evaluated against a peer universe of 10 private and 2 public comparables in the Defense & Security sector. The private peer set includes UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, while public references include DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

A peer-median methodology was applied across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). This cohort yielded a median valuation of $700M with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The peer-median approach is the primary quantifiable method available given limited disclosed financial metrics for the target.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. This range reflects the wide dispersion within the peer set—a 32x spread from minimum to maximum—indicating substantial heterogeneity in stage, geography, and technology maturity across defense-tech comparables. Key uncertainties include Nordic Air Defence's specific technology differentiation relative to peers, capital efficiency to date, and addressable market positioning within Nordic and allied defense procurement cycles. The seed-stage profile and undisclosed fundraising history limit ability to anchor valuation on actual transaction multiples or internal financial performance.
